Flyleaf is kept up by one person in spare time, so not every idea can be
taken up. [the roadmap](https://github.com/ian-c-leonard/flyleaf/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) lists what may come next; say if
your idea is on it.

## What you would like, and why

What would it let you or your family do?
